questions.question_text: Ava eats $\frac{2}{11}$ of a cake. Leo eats $\frac{5}{11}$ of the same cake. What fraction of the cake is left?

options.why: This gives the fraction eaten instead of the fraction left.
This subtracts only Leo's share from the whole cake and ignores Ava's share.

questions.solution_text:
Find the fraction eaten.
$\frac{2}{11}+\frac{5}{11}=\frac{7}{11}$
Find the fraction left.
$1-\frac{7}{11}$
$=\frac{11}{11}-\frac{7}{11}$
$=\frac{4}{11}$
